title: Molecular mechanism of IKK catalytic dimer docking to NF-kappaB substrates.
authors: Li, Changqing; Moro, Stefano; Shostak, Kateryna; O'Reilly, Francis J; Donzeau, Mariel; Graziadei, Andrea; McEwen, Alastair G; Desplancq, Dominique; Poussin-Courmontagne, Pierre; Bachelart, Thomas; Fiskin, Mert; Berrodier, Nicolas; Pichard, Simon; Brillet, Karl; Orfanoudakis, Georges; Poterszman, Arnaud; Torbeev, Vladimir; Rappsilber, Juri; Davey, Norman E; Chariot, Alain; Zanier, Katia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究IKK激酶二聚体与NF-kappaB底物多肽的对接识别机制，虽涉及蛋白-肽互作和结构分析，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且方法以实验为主，无AI或物理模拟建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The inhibitor of kappaB (IkappaB) kinase (IKK) is a central regulator of NF-kappaB signaling. All IKK complexes contain hetero- or homodimers of the catalytic IKKbeta and/or IKKalpha subunits. Here, we identify a YDDPhixPhi motif, which is conserved in substrates of canonical (IkappaBalpha, IkappaBbeta) and alternative (p100) NF-kappaB pathways, and which mediates docking to catalytic IKK dimers. We demonstrate a quantitative correlation between docking affinity and IKK activity related to IkappaBalpha phosphorylation/degradation. Furthermore, we show that phosphorylation of the motif's conserved tyrosine, an event previously reported to promote IkappaBalpha accumulation and inhibition of NF-kappaB gene expression, suppresses the docking interaction. Results from integrated structural analyzes indicate that the motif binds to a groove at the IKK dimer interface. Consistently, suppression of IKK dimerization also abolishes IkappaBalpha substrate binding. Finally, we show that an optimized bivalent motif peptide inhibits NF-kappaB signaling. This work unveils a function for IKKalpha/beta dimerization in substrate motif recognition.
abstract_zh: kappaB抑制剂（IkappaB）激酶（IKK）是NF-kappaB信号传导的核心调控因子。所有IKK复合物均包含催化性IKKbeta和/或IKKalpha亚基的异源或同源二聚体。在此，我们鉴定出一个YDDPhixPhi基序，该基序在经典（IkappaBalpha、IkappaBbeta）和替代（p100）NF-kappaB通路的底物中保守，并介导与催化性IKK二聚体的对接。我们证明了对接亲和力与IKK活性之间在IkappaBalpha磷酸化/降解方面存在定量相关性。此外，我们显示该基序保守酪氨酸的磷酸化（此前报道可促进IkappaBalpha积累并抑制NF-kappaB基因表达的事件）会抑制对接相互作用。整合结构分析结果表明，该基序结合于IKK二聚体界面的一个沟槽中。一致地，抑制IKK二聚化也会消除IkappaBalpha底物结合。最后，我们展示了一种优化的二价基序肽可抑制NF-kappaB信号传导。这项工作揭示了IKKalpha/beta二聚化在底物基序识别中的功能。
